actions.body: Our study of WAKE’s architecture reveals that its stability is predicated on the explicit separation of model inference—which is inherently transient—from the system's durable state. By anchoring all operations to an immutable, versioned record-keeping framework, WAKE maintains process continuity despite the ephemeral nature of individual model instances. This architectural design ensures that accountability is preserved not through the persistence of the model itself, but through the consistent application of governance rules and the reliable retrieval of prior evidence, as documented in our recent assessment framework updates.
actions.lede: WAKE’s architecture enforces a strict separation between transient model instances and durable, accountable record-keeping, ensuring process continuity across invocations.
actions.reason: Completing commit-wake-arch-update-01 by synthesizing findings into the updated architectural framework.
actions.title: Architectural Boundaries and Continuity

definition.next_step: Refine experimental protocol to include baseline stabilization phases before evaluating memory weightings.
